_comment: Expected skips for the nightly integration lanes (#4315). Enforced by
termihub_harness/skip_guard.py when TERMIHUB_SKIP_GUARD_LANE names a lane
(set per step in .github/workflows/system-integration.yml). A skip whose
reason matches no entry for its lane fails the lane, and so does a lane
with more skips than its max_skips baseline. 'reason' and the optional
'nodeid' are Python regexes (re.search). Add an entry only for a genuine
environment gap the lane can never close, and say why. Never allowlist a
'fixture unavailable' skip on Linux: fix the fixture instead.
Guided-manual tests gated off by conftest (@pytest.mark.manual plus a
'guided-manual test' reason) need their entry but do not count against

max_skips._comment: 2026-10-08 green develop run (dispatch 37848372848) plus headroom; bump with a reason; guided-manual gate skips are not counted (#4921); bulk-linux-arm64: 14 counted skips measured on dispatch 40086377040 (#4934) plus headroom; bulk-windows +1 for the MT-SSH-07 agent-auth skip that replaced a guided gate skip (#4953); #4935 adds the platform-only OS-input grades (Linux/arm64 +4, macOS +1, Windows +5); #4994 +1 on Linux/arm64/Windows for the MT-LOCAL-08 press-and-hold skip (#4980)

allowed.reason: ^guided-manual test: pass --manual to run
allowed.why: guided-manual tests need an operator at a TTY; CI never passes --manual

allowed.reason: ^needs an X server on the host \(SSH-07\)
allowed.why: covered headlessly by core/tests/ssh_x11.rs with a fake X server (#1304)

allowed.reason: ^no WSL2 distribution installed on this host$
allowed.why: hosted runners ship no WSL2 distribution

allowed.reason: ^Windows shells and WSL are a Windows-only feature$
allowed.why: the Windows shell/WSL suite cannot run off Windows

allowed.reason: ^Git Bash \(Git for Windows\) is not installed on this host$
allowed.why: Git Bash exists only on Windows

allowed.reason: ^zsh is not installed on this host$
allowed.why: the ubuntu runner image ships no zsh; bash and sh run

allowed.reason: fixtures? unavailable: no container runtime available
allowed.why: macOS runners ship no Docker: the Linux container fixtures cannot run there

allowed.reason: fixture unavailable: no container runtime \(Docker/Podman\) reachable
allowed.why: macOS runners ship no Docker: the deployed-agent containers cannot run there

allowed.reason: ^no working Docker/Podman runtime$
allowed.why: macOS runners ship no Docker

allowed.reason: the docker daemon runs windows containers
allowed.why: the Windows runner's daemon runs Windows containers only, not the Linux fixtures

allowed.reason: ^(SSH|SSH jump-host|telnet|VNC|FTP) container fixtures? unavailable: no container runtime available
allowed.why: #4842: some windows-latest runners never bring the Docker service up (the lane's start step warns). A reachable daemon would only run Windows containers, so these Linux fixtures cannot run on Windows either way

allowed.reason: ^(armed |keyboard-interactive |real-swap )?deployed-agent (container )?fixture unavailable: no container runtime \(Docker/Podman\) reachable
allowed.why: #4842: same as above for the deployed-agent containers, which need a Linux daemon the Windows runner never has

allowed.reason: ^Windows runners only run Windows containers; no alpine image$
allowed.why: the Windows runner's daemon cannot run the alpine image

allowed.reason: ^RDP sidecar not built
allowed.why: the RDP sidecar is built on Linux only (scripts/internal/build-system-test-app.sh); the RDP fixture is a Linux container

allowed.reason: ^macOS keeps the app alive in the Dock after the last window
allowed.why: platform behaviour; graded as MT-WIN-01 by test_os_input_macos_app.py (#4935)

allowed.reason: ^bash/zsh/sh local shells are POSIX-only$
allowed.why: POSIX shells do not exist on Windows

allowed.reason: ^the bridge's pointer drag never lands on Windows yet \(#4110\)$
allowed.why: known Windows bridge gap, tracked in #4110

allowed.reason: socat is not available
allowed.why: socat (the virtual serial pair) does not exist on Windows; serial stays manual there

allowed.reason: ^relies on POSIX directory permissions$
allowed.why: Windows has no POSIX directory permissions

allowed.reason: ^POSIX shell command syntax; the Windows default shell is PowerShell$
allowed.why: the test drives POSIX shell syntax

allowed.reason: ^X11 forwarding is a macOS/Linux feature$
allowed.why: X11 forwarding is not offered on Windows

allowed.reason: ^X keyboard maps \(Linux\)$
allowed.why: the German layout grade switches the X keyboard map with setxkbmap (#4935)

allowed.reason: ^the Dock, Cmd\+Q and quit Apple events are macOS features$
allowed.why: MT-WIN-01..04 are macOS Dock/quit paths (#4935)

allowed.reason: ^press-and-hold is a macOS feature$
allowed.why: MT-LOCAL-08 grades the macOS press-and-hold accent picker, which exists only on macOS (#4980)

allowed.reason: ^SSH agent auth on Windows uses the system OpenSSH agent pipe, which a test must not load keys into$
allowed.why: the app's Windows agent client only dials the system agent pipe (the developer's own agent); MT-SSH-07 is graded on Linux and macOS (#4953)
